verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe found a live, downloadable OpenAPI spec at https://treg.to/openapi.json (HTTP 200, contains the "openapi" key). The docs back this up with 159 documented operations, catalogued endpoints that carry parameters and example responses, and an agent-oriented llms.txt that also probes live. Missing for 10: the docs don't point users to the OpenAPI file, and nothing confirms the spec covers all 159 operations or the /call/ proxy surface.
